description: This file contains helper functions for ASN.1 encoding of CSI measurement configuration data, including creation and diff calculation of various CSI-related ASN.1 structures, such as resources, reports, and configurations, for 3GPP NR specifications.

methods.name: make_asn1_nzp_csi_rs_resource_mapping
methods.description: Creates ASN.1 resource mapping structure from CSI resource mapping configuration.

methods.name: make_asn1_csi_resource_periodicity_and_offset
methods.description: Creates ASN.1 periodicity and offset structure for CSI resources.

methods.name: make_asn1_zp_csi_rs_resource
methods.description: Creates ASN.1 zero-power CSI-RS resource structure.

methods.name: make_asn1_zp_csi_rs_resource_set
methods.description: Creates ASN.1 set of zero-power CSI-RS resources.

methods.name: make_asn1_nzp_csi_rs_resource
methods.description: Creates ASN.1 non-zero-power CSI-RS resource structure.

methods.name: make_asn1_nzp_csi_rs_resource_set
methods.description: Creates ASN.1 set of non-zero-power CSI-RS resources.

methods.name: make_asn1_csi_im_resource_set
methods.description: Creates ASN.1 set of CSI-IM resources.

methods.name: make_asn1_csi_ssb_resource_set
methods.description: Creates ASN.1 set of SSB resources for CSI.

methods.name: make_asn1_csi_resource_config
methods.description: Creates ASN.1 CSI resource configuration structure.

methods.name: make_asn1_csi_report_config
methods.description: Creates ASN.1 CSI report configuration structure.

methods.name: make_asn1_aperiodic_trigger_state
methods.description: Creates ASN.1 aperiodic trigger state structure.

methods.name: make_asn1_semi_persistent_on_pusch_trigger_state
methods.description: Creates ASN.1 semi-persistent on PUSCH trigger state structure.

methods.name: calculate_csi_meas_config_diff
methods.description: Calculates the difference between two CSI measurement configurations and outputs ASN.1 diff structure.
